subject.title: WeCom（企业微信）发送消息后 agent 无响应

question: Is this thin WeCom no-response report enough for maintainers to spend live repro time, or should it wait for reporter-provided version/config/log evidence?
rationale: The observable symptom is real if reproduced, but current source and related issues leave multiple plausible owners and no high-confidence failing current-main path.

options.title: Request a redacted trace
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask for OpenClaw version, plugin version, relevant channel config, gateway logs, and WeCom plugin logs from a latest-release group mention.

options.title: Run maintainer live repro
options.body: A maintainer with WeCom access can reproduce the group-turn path and then route it to core delivery, catalog pinning, or the external plugin.

options.title: Close later if no data arrives
options.body: If no new reproduction data appears after the normal stale window, close as insufficient information rather than guessing a root cause.

recommendation.title: Request a redacted trace
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and ask for OpenClaw version, plugin version, relevant channel config, gateway logs, and WeCom plugin logs from a latest-release group mention.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the best OpenClaw-side owner from current catalog and group-reply policy history; external plugin owners should be involved only after logs implicate plugin runtime behavior.
